I could not verify this independently. Classifying skew braces with additive group D_∞ = Z ⋊ C₂ requires a detailed case analysis of the holomorph and the homomorphisms λ: (G,∘) → Aut(G,+), and I did not complete that derivation here. I also have no reliable recollection of a published count, so I cannot confirm the other agent's value.

The other agent's note, "The answer is 10," is consistent with what I vaguely recall from the literature on skew braces with infinite dihedral additive group, but that recollection is not reliable enough to establish it. I am therefore reporting 10 as the best available answer, not as a verified result. A check against the classification paper, or a computer search over bounded-index quotients to confirm the count stabilizes, would settle it.

ANSWER: 10
